scenes.title: A digital twin must represent the right state
scenes.detail: A visually realistic twin is useful only when its articulated state matches the physical robot at the observation time.

caption.en: KineSync-GS addresses a missing link in Real2Sim2Real. Gaussian Splatting can reproduce a robot visually, but a useful digital twin must also represent the physical robot's articulated state at the correct time.
caption.zh: KineSync-GS 关注 Real2Sim2Real 中一个容易被忽略的环节。Gaussian Splatting 可以逼真重现机器人外观，但有用的数字孪生还必须在正确时刻表示真实机器人的关节状态。

scenes.title: Image fitting and state recovery can diverge
scenes.detail: A stale or conflicting image may reward a pose that looks better while moving the joints farther from the physical state.

caption.en: The difficulty appears when cameras are delayed or views disagree. Direct inverse rendering can keep lowering image error while joint error rises. A visually improved estimate therefore cannot receive automatic authority to modify the twin.
caption.zh: 当相机存在延迟或多个视角互相冲突时，问题就会出现。直接逆渲染可能持续降低图像误差，却让关节误差不断上升。因此，视觉上更好的估计不能自动获得修改数字孪生的权限。

scenes.title: Separate estimation from state-changing authority
scenes.detail: Rendering or motion proposes a correction; evidence decides whether the synchronized state changes.

caption.en: KineSync-GS separates two decisions. Rendering or motion first proposes a bounded correction. Cross-view or motion evidence then determines whether the proposal is committed as a verified update or the incoming measurement is preserved.
caption.zh: KineSync-GS 将两个决定分开。渲染或运动首先提出受约束的修正，再由跨视角或运动证据决定提交验证更新，还是保留输入测量。

scenes.title: Spatial verification commits one coordinated state
scenes.detail: Fixed kinematics bind Gaussians to links; separately recovered views verify the fused whole-state proposal.

caption.en: For spatial synchronization, fixed kinematics bind Gaussians to robot links and inverse rendering estimates one coordinated joint correction. View-specific estimates provide evidence for the complete proposal, which is committed atomically or rejected as a whole.
caption.zh: 在空间同步中，固定运动学将高斯绑定到机械臂连杆，逆渲染估计一个协调一致的关节修正。各视角估计为完整提议提供证据，使其整体提交或整体拒绝。

scenes.title: Motion evidence aligns cameras with telemetry
scenes.detail: Residual lag is proposed from motion correlation and committed only when timing evidence supports resampling.

caption.en: The temporal path instantiates the same contract. Image and telemetry motion propose a residual lag after native-delay correction. Timing evidence then selects corrected resampling or preserves the original camera-to-state association.
caption.zh: 时间路径遵循同一契约。图像与遥测运动在校正固有延迟后提出剩余时差，再由时间证据选择校正重采样，或保留原始相机与状态关联。

scenes.title: Whole-state verification resolves view conflict
scenes.detail: All 12 helpful proposals are retained, with zero harmful update across the complete evaluation.

caption.en: On twelve held-out Franka poses and forty-eight view-offset conditions, KineSync-GS reduces whole-state joint error from zero point five nine zero to zero point three two two degrees. It retains all twelve helpful proposals and makes no harmful update.
caption.zh: 在十二个未见 Franka 姿态和四十八个视角偏移条件上，KineSync-GS 将全状态关节误差从 0.590 度降至 0.322 度，保留全部十二个有益提议，并且没有产生有害更新。

scenes.title: Stronger evidence sharpens update decisions
scenes.detail: Factorized calibration strengthens dual-view recovery; re-verification retains more successful proposals.

caption.en: The mechanism ablations explain this selectivity. Factorized calibration raises dual-view recovery from forty-two point eight six to eighty point nine five percent, while component re-verification retains eighty-eight point eight nine percent of successful proposals.
caption.zh: 机制消融解释了这种选择性。因子化标定将双视角恢复率从 42.86% 提升到 80.95%，组件重验证则保留了 88.89% 的成功提议。

scenes.title: The same contract transfers to real PiPER motion
scenes.detail: Cross-view evidence aligns the Gaussian gripper while publishing a task-ready state stream.

caption.en: Real-world PiPER recordings evaluate the same interface under physical motion and matched head and wrist cameras. Cross-view evidence aligns the rendered gripper while the verified state remains available throughout corn-to-plate execution.
caption.zh: 真实 PiPER 记录在物理运动以及匹配的头部和腕部相机下评估同一接口。跨视角证据对齐渲染夹爪，并在玉米放盘任务全过程中持续发布验证状态。

scenes.title: Spatial and temporal evidence remain complementary online
scenes.detail: The verified combination preserves high recovery while reducing harmful updates by more than an order of magnitude.

caption.en: In the complete online chain, spatial and temporal evidence are complementary. KineSync-GS reaches three point zero seven milliradians qMAE with eighty-three point zero five percent recovery and only zero point three six percent harmful updates.
caption.zh: 在完整在线链路中，空间与时间证据形成互补。KineSync-GS 达到 3.07 毫弧度 qMAE、83.05% 恢复率，同时有害更新仅为 0.36%。

scenes.title: A synchronized state improves unchanged policies
scenes.detail: Task success increases across Take-Pens, Red-Cube-to-Plate, and Corn-to-Plate.

caption.en: Most importantly, synchronization improves downstream manipulation without changing the policy. Across two hundred forty paired real-robot episodes, task-macro success rises from fifty-eight point three three to seventy-one point six seven percent.
caption.zh: 更重要的是，同步在不改变策略的情况下改善了下游操控。在二百四十个配对真机 episode 上，任务宏平均成功率从 58.33% 提升到 71.67%。

scenes.title: One verified state interface across robot stacks
scenes.detail: Rendering and motion share one update contract for Gaussian twins, simulators, and downstream policies.

caption.en: KineSync-GS turns visual evidence into a verified state-changing interface across Gaussian twins, simulators, and downstream robot policies.
caption.zh: KineSync-GS 将视觉证据转化为经过验证的状态修改接口，连接 Gaussian 数字孪生、仿真器与下游机器人策略。
